claims.assertion: Anéeka says speaking a human language entails absorbing its culture, shaping the Taygetans' adapted presentation.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says observers see this adapted side, not their full identity.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says written-chat contact replaced one-to-one outreach because a 36-person crew could not meet millions of starseeds individually.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: They use human intermediaries to reach larger audiences.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Earth's Matrix is generated by people and their mental conditioning, and awakening gradually erodes it.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says people attack differing views themselves rather than following a central computer.
